resolutions.title: As-of-completion gate computation is scoped too narrowly for current review passes
resolutions.action: Rewrote the as-of-completion scenario into 'Final assessment counts the current pass (as-of-completion, both modes)': orbit-review computes gate state over the on-disk trail PLUS a synthetic pass for the active run (mode, reviewer_class, now-token, about-to-be-written review-<mode>-<TS>.json path, current findings), with explicit consequences for (a) proposal current --fresh run with no prior independent pass, (b) proposal current in-context trailing slot, (c) system current in-context after a converged external (supplies the trailing in-context slot so Path A/B PASSED is reachable), (d) any-mode current pass with findings -> address-reviews targets the just-written JSON. status/instructions stay on-disk only. Added a governing intro sentence so ALL convergence branches evaluate over trail+synthetic-pass (fixes the literal-P1-fires-for-current-fresh-run bug).

resolutions.title: Proposal unresolved-findings branch does not cover mixed independent-pass histories
resolutions.action: Broadened the unresolved branch from 'the most recent independent-class pass' to ANY gate-relevant pass (independent OR in-context), matching orbit-engine-gates clause (b) 'every pass's findings resolved'. Neutral source wording ('a prior gate-relevant pass'; <unresolved-path> resolves to review-<mode>-<TS>.json OR external-<as>-<TS>.md, both valid --from-file inputs). Defined the multi-source tie-break (most recent unresolved by <TS>; each address-reviews run clears one, the next assessment surfaces the next until clause (b) holds for all). Added an explicit precedence note (this branch beats new-findings/trailing-in-context/gate-passed).
